phase_japanese_name: デュアルゲート解除判定レポート設計
purpose: Design the dual-gate unlock judgment report that consumes the Phase 19-7 final verification report and Phase 19-3 cross-validation outcome to produce the definitive DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED or DUAL_GATE_LOCKED determination, which is the gate condition for app/tests implementation authorization

scope_1_unlock_preconditions.description: Define all preconditions that must be satisfied before dual-gate unlock can be assessed

precondition_1.failure_outcome: DUAL_GATE_LOCKED (prerequisite not met; route to Phase 19-7 rejection handling)

precondition_3.condition: Phase 19-5 evidence locks for both records have tamper_detection_status = ALL_PASS

precondition_5.condition: Phase 19-8 judgment is executed by authorized authority with valid digital signature
precondition_5.failure_outcome: JUDGMENT_INVALID (unsigned or unauthorized judgment not accepted)

scope_2_dual_gate_judgment_logic.description: Define the judgment logic for DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED or DUAL_GATE_LOCKED

rule_DG_1.condition: integrated_decision_actual = GO AND receiver_validator_permission_actual = EFFECTIVE AND dual_gate_status_from_cross_validation = DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED
rule_DG_1.note: All three conditions must be simultaneously true

rule_DG_2.note: integrated_decision=NO_GO means Phase 15-7 measurement failed; no unlock possible

rule_DG_3.note: receiver_validator_permission=NOT_EFFECTIVE means Phase 15-8 measurement failed; no unlock possible

rule_DG_4.note: Even if individual results are GO and EFFECTIVE, cross-validation inconsistency keeps gate locked

rule_DG_5.description: If rule_DG_2 or DG_3 or DG_4 fires, outcome is DUAL_GATE_LOCKED regardless of other conditions
rule_DG_5.note: DUAL_GATE_LOCKED conditions always take precedence over UNLOCKED

scope_3_report_structure.description: Design the structure of the dual-gate unlock judgment report

section_3_dual_gate_determination.determination_basis: Rule DG_x triggered; all three conditions met / condition Y not met

notes.if_DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED: app_implementation_unlock_authorized=YES; tests_implementation_unlock_authorized=YES. Proceed to Phase 19-9 completion declaration.
notes.if_DUAL_GATE_LOCKED: app_implementation_unlock_authorized=NO; tests_implementation_unlock_authorized=NO. Document failing conditions and route to appropriate remediation.

remediation_paths.if_integrated_decision_NO_GO: Re-execute Phase 15-7 measurement. Cannot unlock without integrated_decision=GO.
remediation_paths.if_receiver_validator_NOT_EFFECTIVE: Re-execute Phase 15-8 measurement. Cannot unlock without receiver_validator_permission=EFFECTIVE.
remediation_paths.if_cross_validation_locked: Re-examine Phase 19-3 cross-checks. Resolve inconsistencies. May require re-execution of one or both measurements.

scope_4_implementation_gate_conditions.description: Define the gate conditions for app and tests implementation authorization

app_implementation_gate.current_status_reason: integrated_decision=NO_GO and receiver_validator_permission=NOT_EFFECTIVE (design phase; no measurement executed)

tests_implementation_gate.current_status_reason: integrated_decision=NO_GO and receiver_validator_permission=NOT_EFFECTIVE (design phase; no measurement executed)

gate_conditions.invariant_note: These gate conditions remain LOCKED throughout all design phases. Only actual Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement execution (not design) can change these states.

phase_19_8_completion_criteria: 5 judgment rules (DG_1 through DG_5 precedence) designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
